newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Storage sees Q4 net below Q3.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Storage sees Q4 net below Q3.

text.p: Silicon Storage Technology Wednesday said sales and profits for the fourth quarter, ending December 31 will fall below the company's performance in the third quarter of 1996.

In a statement, the company said, based on actual quarter-to-date results, it believes it will not meet internally targeted order, revenue, and profitability levels due to unexpected softness in PC BIOS orders and shipments in December, and a steeper than expected market-driven decline in average selling prices throughout the fourth quarter.

In October, the company reported a third quarter profit of $3.69 million, or $0.15 a share, on revenues of $23.4 million. According to First Call, analysts had expected the company to report a fourth-quarter profit of $0.13 a share.

Silicon Storage said the lower-than-expected shipment rate and lower average selling prices will constrain net revenues and result in lower gross margins as compared to the prior quarter. Cost of sales is also expected to be higher due to less favorable manufacturing variances during the quarter.
The company also said operating expenses are expected to be higher in absolute dollars and as a percentage of net revenues, when compared to the prior quarter.

"Our net revenues, gross margins and earnings per share will continue to be very sensitive to market-driven declines in average selling prices as we ramp our production to more cost effective die geometry's and introduce new products," said Bing Yeh, president and chief executive officer. "We are focused on implementing die geometry shrinks to 0.5 micron over the next several quarters and expect to see the benefits of these cost reduction efforts in the second half of 1997."

"In order to complete these die geometry shrinks and develop new products, we anticipate a higher investment in R&D throughout the next several quarters," he said. "As a result, our financial performance will likely remain constrained during the first half of 1997.
